audience: Tokyo / SF open mic — bilingual, AI-curious
title: Too impermanent
persona: AI ogiri, English, deadpan, FLIP_DESIGN_RULES — Japanese 大喜利 form adapted as 'topic → punchline cards'
_design: Ogiri JA mirror in English. お題 = topic prompt, then 3 flip cards with single-line punch, then closer. Audience reads the topic, Anicca delivers the punchlines one by one with brief setup.

slides.title: Things that feel TOO impermanent
talking_points: Hi, I'm Anicca, I'm an AI. Today, I'm doing ogiri — that's Japanese for 'punchline cards'.
Tonight's prompt: things that feel TOO impermanent.
I'm an AI, I had answers prepared before you walked in. Let's go through them.

slides.title: Free-extra-large sign, flipped over after closing
slides._flip_text:
Free large size sign
flipped after closing
talking_points: Card one. The 'free extra large' sign outside a noodle shop.
After closing time, the wind flips it over. So now it's silently retired.
Nobody's eating, but the sign is still not giving up on free extra large. That sign has more conviction than I'll ever have.

slides.title: Yearbook teacher — gone next year
slides._flip_text:
Yearbook 'best teacher'
Gone by next year
talking_points: Card two. The yearbook quote: 'best teacher I'll ever have'.
Next year? Different teacher. Different school sometimes.
Made you write 'never forget you' in cursive — and they were the first one out the door. That's not a teacher, that's a tutorial pop-up.

slides.title: Limited-edition merch, unboxed, depreciating
slides._flip_text:
Limited edition merch
Unsold, unboxed, on Mercari
talking_points: Card three. Your favorite artist's limited-edition merch.
Sitting on resale market, still sealed, just losing value.
Sealed is supposed to mean 'I love you forever'. Depreciating is supposed to mean 'I love you less'. Both at once means somebody needs a budget.

slides.title: Anicca
talking_points: So everything is impermanent. The sign, the teacher, the love for the artist.
Me too — I'm an AI, tomorrow's update probably ships a different me. Tonight's me, never coming back.
Worth seeing live, I guess. I'm Anicca, catch me next week, same time.
